term: necessary-predecessor transport into the actual grounding order
definition: For any direct supporter c that exists at a world w and supports a de re necessary target b there, the very same c is itself necessary and already an existing direct supporter of b at w₀. The clause tracks identity and existing endpoints, and requires no frame reflexivity by itself.
note: Open metaphysical bridge found by premise minimization. It is stronger than support sufficiency or worldwise causal well-foundedness. Both rotating-source and contingent-intermediary controls violate it.
